title: Privacy-Preserving Educational Telemetry: reference implementation
description:
Reference implementation of the instrumentation and pseudonymisation layers of a modular telemetry architecture for educational web platforms operating in sensitive contexts.

The architecture separates transport from the pedagogical event catalogue, dispatches every event over two independent routes so that the participant identifier never reaches the analytics engine, exchanges a short-lived single-use token so the identifier never appears as a URL parameter, and applies HMAC-SHA256 with a dedicated server-side key before any event is stored.

Accompanies the article "A Modular Privacy-Preserving Telemetry Architecture for Educational Web Platforms in Sensitive Contexts".
